budget.rationale: The five-category rollup is approximately $9,300–$16,200 and reconciles with the detailed lines. Its lodging and one-way-car tails put the high case above the $15,000 preference, so the rubric supports 1/5; no July 2027 quotes are claimed.

weather.rationale: NOAA 1991–2020 July normals bracket the route: San Diego 75.3/66.1°F and downtown San Francisco 66.3/54.4°F, with a cool marine coast between them. This supports comfortable touring but real fog/layering, not a July 2027 forecast.

fireRisk.rationale: High is the safety rating (2/5), corresponding to a 10–20% planning chance of material wildfire disruption during the exact trip window. July is an active California fire month, and this itinerary repeatedly crosses exposed coastal ranges and single-corridor road sections around Santa Barbara, San Luis Obispo, Big Sur, and Monterey. A fire need not reach a hotel to close Highway 1, create smoke, or force a long reroute.

swim.rationale: NOAA July monthly means are about 67.6°F at La Jolla but only 58.4°F at Monterey and 59.6°F at San Francisco. Natural swimming is therefore a San Diego-only, cool-water opportunity; the later coast is scenery/wildlife, not family swimming.

variety.rationale: The 13-day route schedules San Diego beach/pool time, four major family attractions, Big Sur/Point Lobos wildlife and coastal scenery, and four distinct town/city bases.

ease.rationale: Four bases, three moves, and the long Santa Barbara–Hearst–Big Sur–Monterey transfer create moderate deterministic load (3/5).

food.rationale: Official Vons and Safeway pages verify full supermarkets with produce, bakery, deli, pantry staples and prepared-food services in San Diego, Santa Barbara, Monterey and San Francisco. Plain-food coverage is robust today; exact lodging kitchens and July 2027 store hours remain rechecks.

risk.rationale: The open-jaw domestic flight/road shape is credible, but July 2027 fares and the one-way car are unquoted. Caltrans reopened through Big Sur in 2026 yet documents repeated slide closures and ongoing controls, so Highway 1 remains a mandatory live gate; Independence Day weekend also raises crowd pressure.

nights.rationale: 12 hotel nights derives a 5/5 score from the canonical nights rubric.

novelty.rationale: Novelty is derived from the documented visited-place overlap list; this route scores 1/5 under that rubric.

pto.rationale: 7 PTO days derives a 4/5 slider score and has zero default weight.
